text:
Yash: Quick heads up — I'm going to run a heavy memory stress job for ~2h. I want to suppress the noisy GPU memory OOM alerts (they're spamming the channel) and route them to #oncall-noise temporarily. Will not escalate unless it flips to severity=critical or SLOs are affected.

Nina: Where exactly will you change the rule? Alertmanager? Thanks for the notice.

Yash: Yes, temporary change in Alertmanager. Snippet I'm applying (temp):

```yaml
- alert: GPUMemoryOOM
  expr: gpu_memory_usage > 0.92
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    route: oncall-noise
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU memory OOM (temp reroute)"
```

Sophie: So critical alerts still page eng-oncall, right? We don't want to silence true service hits.

Yash: Correct — I only change the route for the warning-level rule. Anything with label severity=critical or the existing critical expr stays on the normal pager.

Oncall Bot: Automated note: Alert routing updated for GPUMemoryOOM (warning) -> oncall-noise (temporary). Change ID: tmp-20260317-01.

Liam: I'll be taking the 16:00 handoff. Please ping me 15m before you flip, Yash. Also leave the roll-forward/rollback note in the handoff doc.

Yash: Will ping at 15:45 and add a short entry in the handoff doc (links: https://redwood.internal/docs/oncall/handoffs).

Sara: Small FYI — the canary inference job is sensitive to memory backpressure; if you see increased inference latency >500ms for canary, stop the stress run.

Yash: Noted. I'll watch canary latency in the console and abort if >500ms sustained for 3m.

Nina: Also, can you bump the warning threshold from 0.85 -> 0.92 only for the stress window? Document it please.

Yash: Yes bumping to 0.92 for 2h. Will post revert message when I flip it back.

Sophie: If anything comes up that's critical, I'll escalate to the on-call rotation (page) — otherwise I'll let this ride in #oncall-noise. :thumbsup:

Liam: Ack, standing by. I put my contact in the handoff doc.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: If a routed alert receives >=2 instances in 5m labeled severity=critical, automatic escalation will trigger to eng-pager.

Yash: Change applied at 16:05. Monitoring for canary. I'll post a revert message when finished (expected ~18:05).

Sophie: Thanks. If you want a quick CR to walk through the change I can review.

Yash: Not needed for this temporary tweak but I copied the snippet to the ops-runbook.

--- 2 hours later ---

Yash: Reverted the temporary routing and threshold at 18:22. Alertmanager change tmp-20260317-01 removed. Everything back to normal.

Nina: Thanks for the heads up and revert.

Liam: Good handoff; I'm taking over now.

Sara: Verified canary latency stayed <500ms. All good.

Oncall Bot: Automated note: Change tmp-20260317-01 marked closed.
